NonRootFolderPathInput.description: Non-root folder path. A missing leading slash is normalized before validation. Segments are percent-encoded, so a folder shown as "New folder" is `/New%20folder`: everything outside `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~` is escaped as uppercase hex, and only that exact encoding is accepted. A trailing slash, an empty segment, and a literal `.` or `..` segment are rejected. At most 64 segments and 4096 encoded bytes.

path.title: Non-root folder path
path.description: Canonical folder path used as the public folder identifier.

parentPath.title: Folder path
parentPath.description: Canonical parent path; `/` is the root.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the folder was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the folder was last updated.

files.description: Files restored inside the folder tree.

folders.description: Folders restored, including the one addressed.

V2FileFolderRestore.title: Folder restore result
V2FileFolderRestore.description: The restored folder and the counts of items it brought back.

query.description: Regular expression, or exact text when `mode` is `exact`.

folderPaths.description: Folders the search is confined to, comma-separated. Absent searches the whole workspace. The scope also narrows `indexStatus`, so `complete` describes the folders searched rather than the workspace.

includeSubfolders.description: Whether the scope descends into nested folders. Absent means yes. The listed spellings are the whole accepted vocabulary and are case-sensitive; any other value is rejected.

results.description: Matching lines, one entry per line.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist beyond `maxResults`.

complete.description: True when no files in the searched scope have pending or failed indexing. Missing matches remain inconclusive unless this is true and both `indexStatus.skippedFiles` and `indexStatus.partialFiles` are zero.

readyFiles.description: Files whose current revision is indexed and searchable.

pendingFiles.description: Files not yet indexed at their current revision. Their content was not searched.

failedFiles.description: Files whose indexing failed. Their content was not searched.

skippedFiles.description: Files deliberately not indexed, such as binaries and files above the size ceiling.

partialFiles.description: Files indexed only in part, so matches beyond the indexed portion are not found.

indexStatus.description: Index coverage across the searched scope.

V2FileSearchResults.title: File search results
V2FileSearchResults.description: Matching lines from indexed workspace file content, with index coverage.

folderPath.title: Folder path
folderPath.description: Canonical path of the folder the archive was unpacked into. May differ from the archive name when a sibling folder already claimed it.

extractedFileCount.description: Number of files written into the destination folder.

skippedFileCount.description: Number of archive entries skipped as unsafe, empty, or noise.

V2FileUnzipResult.title: Unzip result
V2FileUnzipResult.description: Outcome of unzipping a workspace archive into a folder.

content.description: Complete replacement content for the file. The complete JSON request is capped at 10 MiB, including UTF-8 encoding, escaping, base64, and the envelope. The separate decoded-file limit is 50 MiB. Small patches can edit a larger stored text file without sending its full content.

expectedRevision.description: Revision from Get file metadata or an earlier write; the request is refused with `409` when the content moved on.

webUrl.description: Canonical absolute URL for opening this resource in the Sim web application.

size.description: Size in bytes of the stored file. For a generated document (docx, pptx, pdf, xlsx) this is the generation source, not the rendered document, so it does not predict how many bytes downloading the file returns.

type.description: MIME type of the stored file. For a generated document (docx, pptx, pdf, xlsx) this is the generation source type, not the rendered document type a download serves.

folderPath.title: Folder path
folderPath.description: Canonical containing-folder path. `/` is the workspace root.

uploadedByEmail.description: Current email address of the uploader.

uploadedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the file was uploaded.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last content or metadata write.

deletedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the file was archived by deleting it, or null while the file is active. Only an archived-scope file list returns files with a non-null value.

revision.description: Opaque token for the content this write produced. Send it back as `expectedRevision` on the next write. Absent for a file with no recorded content version.

V2WrittenFile.title: Written file
V2WrittenFile.description: A workspace file after a content replacement, with the revision it produced.

isActive.description: Whether the share should resolve. Disabling preserves the token and the whole access configuration, so re-enabling restores the share as it was; enabling rewrites the credentials the resulting mode does not use.

authType.description: How access to the share is gated. The stored mode is kept when omitted. Enabling `public` clears the stored password and empties `allowedEmails`; `password` empties `allowedEmails`; `email` and `sso` clear the stored password.

password.description: Password of 15 to 1024 characters for a password-gated share. Kept when omitted; enabling `password` with neither a supplied nor a stored password is a 400. Taken literally, except that a request from the Sim agent resolves a whole-value `{{ENV_VAR}}` reference to that variable before the rules apply.

allowedEmails.description: Allowed addresses or `@domain` patterns for email and SSO shares. Kept when omitted; enabling `email` or `sso` with an empty resulting list is a 400.

token.description: Server-generated token embedded in the public share URL.

isActive.description: Whether the public share currently resolves.

authType.description: How access to the share is gated.

hasPassword.description: Whether a password is stored for this share.

allowedEmails.description: Allowed addresses or @domain patterns for email and SSO shares.

V2FileShare.title: File share
V2FileShare.description: Public-safe share configuration for a file.
